newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai rice ends mixed in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai rice ends mixed in slow trade.

text.p: Shanghai rice futures ended mixed in slow trading on Thursday with most investors staying on the sidelines, traders said.
The key October 1996 contract ended at 2,302 yuan ($277) per tonne, rising two yuan. It opened at an intra-day low of 2,300 and hit a high of 2,303.
December fell 82 yuan to 2,500 yuan. The previous trade was on Sept 4.
Combined volume rose to 1,900 tonnes from 1,300.
Traders said rice moved little due to most investors staying on the sidelines.
"Most retail investors lost interest in trading after suffering losses from the September contract," one trader said.
Institutional long-squeezing on the September contract have resulted in many retail investors suffering heavy losses over the past few weeks.
Traders said rice was likely to consolidate around 2,300 yuan in the next few days.
